notes: New marketplace crop presets: 1:1 (1000/1080/1500), 3:4, 4:5, 16:9 and 750x1000 detail size.
One tap crops your photo to the marketplace ratio without stretching or distorting the product.
Images are compressed automatically on export to stay under 2MB, keeping quality and proportions.
The same size can be applied to all nine images at once.
Compare with the original is now a simple tap, and one reset button restores the initial look.
